homekit.privacy.body:
Read below for a detailed explanation of what this data contains:

<emph>· Current state:</emph> You’ll share the state of all lights and accessories, including their on/off state, product activity, brightness and colour settings, motion sensor status (motion, temperature, and brightness) and button-press status. The application will also have access to the timestamp of the last state change of all connected products, including sensors.

<emph>· Names:</emph> Any names you defined in your Hue system, including but not limited to rooms, scenes, types and light groupings.

Only share access with people you trust: guests added via Matter can also extend that access to others.

If you want to find out more about how your data will be handled, please read Apple’s Privacy Notice.

homekit.settings.exportAllPopup.body:
If you’ve made any changes to your setup in the Hue app that did not sync automatically in Apple Home, you can sync these changes manually. Tap Sync below.

Note: The complete set-up, including lights, Rooms and devices will be synced to Apple Home. It will not affect other smart devices in Apple Home.

homekit.settings.resetPopup.body:
<emph>Only unlink Apple Home if you’re experiencing problems!</emph>

Unlinking Apple Home will remove it from your Hue Bridge.

You will not be able to control any of your Hue devices with Apple Home until you set them up again.
